assumptions.statement: Overall and key-area polygons are rough provisional constraints, not official boundaries.
assumptions.impact: All location, area and topology outputs must be recomputed after official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: Statutory controls, road redlines, ownership, existing buildings, utilities, fire and heritage constraints are unavailable in cleared machine-readable form.
assumptions.impact: FAR, height, density, retain/renovate/demolish and construction decisions remain unknown.

assumptions.statement: Concept building and connection layers do not assert existing buildings, vacancies or legal access.
assumptions.impact: Every site requires survey, owner consent and professional review before a pilot.

assumptions.statement: Pilot counts, durations, paid places and programme operators are design recommendations, not funding or government commitments.
assumptions.impact: Implementation begins only after labour, privacy, safety, accessibility, rights and operating approvals.
